notes.title: “Far Away” English Version has been released! Share and enter the lucky draw!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The English version of "Far Away" has already been released！
Players who have purchased the game can check the version by updating the game. 
Share the exciting news on your SNS and enter the lucky draw!

If the game language is not changed automatically, you can manually change it in the following way:
Steam Library--Home--Find "Far Away"--Right click--Properties--General--Language--Choose English

If you counter any questions, please feel free to contact by Email or Discord, we will always be online.

To express our gratitude for your long wait, we've decided to give away some CD keys, which you can share with your friends after the version is released! 

How to participate:  
Share the news of "Far Away"  English version launch on your SNS(any public social platform), then fill in the share link and your contact information on the Google Forms: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUDNNZFtk0lAAKW6JsoBe2Evd7ogITxsXkYuIPJ_UK_MpmwQ/viewform?usp=dialog, 
and join the official Discord: https://discord.gg/pT4nK8hN34  


We will randomly select 10 players from every 100 participants to receive a Far Away CD key. The winners will be announced on Discord, and there will be more activities to come, so don't miss out!

LQA: 萤火熠动信息科技有限公司
Special Thanks: Talon, Tongmeow


----

notes.title: Far Away Ver 1.0.9 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for all your support for Far Away! We've just updated the game patch to Ver 1.0.9.

[Update Time]
March 8th, 2023

[Adjustment]
Updated the ending videos of "Daughter of Sand" and "After Story" in the game to the version that includes the names of our crowdfunding backers.

If you have any other questions or concerns, please let us know.

[Additional Information]
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.

Thanks again for everything and let us meet in Bedjan!

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Gratesca_Studio
